summary: Bound retries for unreadable stop observations and report processes that survive SIGKILL.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Retries for an unreadable stop observation start at 100 milliseconds and double to a 30-second cap. After ten minutes, a WARN and a daemon diagnostic report that teardown is still pending. Agent and exec stops also record an unreachable decision, which readable state clears. The stop is never recorded as stopped while the observation is unreadable. A survivor is reported only when the next observation after SIGKILL is still running; the immediate process-group scan is removed. Gate operations report survivors through a daemon diagnostic instead of a runtime decision, so the existing survivor branch no longer fails for gates. The claim schema and checkpoint rules are unchanged, so mixed-version peers accept every claim written.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to use the change. Interruption duration has not been measured.

recovery.detail: Retry and warning-deduplication state is local and resets on restart. Completed or inactive operations release that state. A later unreadable episode produces a new diagnostic, while repeated ticks within one episode remain deduplicated. Rollback restores the previous retry and reporting behavior.
